_comment: Tidal Flight amphibious seaplane requirements. Same layout as the IHW1 file Ttpa_requirements.json (geometry, design_range_nmi, missions), plus a payload block and a weights block. In IHW1 the payload (1200 lb) and the OEW constants were literals inside TtpaWeights; they live here now so there is one place to change them. Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are never read by code.

geometry._src_AR: PLACEHOLDER carried over from the TTPA. Check against the 65 ft span limit once S_ref is known: b = sqrt(AR * S_ref).
geometry._src_max_span_ft: RFP aircraft requirement: wingspan below 65 ft.

payload._comment: Read by TidalWeights as J['payload']. W_payload_fixed = n_passengers*(passenger_weight_lb + baggage_per_passenger_lb) + n_pilots*pilot_weight_lb = 9*230 + 2*180 = 2430 lb.
payload._src_payload: RFP: 9 passengers with 50 lb of baggage each and two pilots; passengers and pilots assumed to weigh 180 lb. The TTPA equivalent was 1 pilot + 5 passengers at 200 lb each = 1200 lb.

weights._comment: Read by TidalWeights as J['weights']. OEW = K_seaplane * A * W_TO^exponent.
weights._src_regression: IHW1 empty-weight regression (Nicolai light-prop fit, We/W0 = 0.911 * W0^-0.053, so We = 0.911 * W0^0.947). Replace if the team adopts a different fit.
weights._src_K_seaplane: PLACEHOLDER seaplane multiplier (hull/floats, retractable gear, corrosion protection, water loads). Calibrate as (Caravan amphibian OEW) / (Caravan landplane OEW) from the Wipaire and Cessna spec sheets, then cite. Use 1.0 to reproduce the IHW1 equation exactly.

_src_design_range_nmi: RFP design range of 1000 statute miles = 869 nmi (1 nmi = 1.15078 mi). Payload is the full 9 passengers and 2 pilots.

missions._comment: Mission profile in the IHW1 layout. Requirement data only. Owned by the mission analysis teammate; shown here so the file is complete.

std_mission._description: Design mission: startup, taxi, takeoff, climb, cruise, descent, balked-landing climb, 45 min IFR reserve loiter, descent, landing.
std_mission._cite_reserve_fuel_fraction: PLACEHOLDER carried over from the TTPA as a trapped/unusable allowance. The RFP's 45 min IFR reserve is the loiter segment below. The mission owner decides whether this stays.
std_mission._src_cruise: RFP: 869 nmi (1000 mi) at 180 KTAS, 10,000 ft density altitude.
std_mission._src_loiter: RFP: 45 min IFR reserve energy, balked landing at the start of the reserve. The 110 KTAS loiter speed is a PLACEHOLDER.
